ex.en: His sharp intellect and wide reading made him a popular lecturer among students.
ex.zh: 他敏锐的才智与广博的阅读使他成为深受学生欢迎的讲师。

words.note: intellect 指思维能力本身；intellectual 指知识分子，注意词性区别。

ex.en: Most guests expressed a preference for quiet rooms away from the main road.
ex.zh: 多数客人都表示更喜欢远离主路的安静房间。

words.note: 常搭配 have a preference for；动词 prefer 后接 to。

ex.en: The patient had only mild symptoms and was sent home without any medicine.
ex.zh: 病人只有轻微症状，未开药便回家了。

words.note: mild 修饰气候、症状、味道，表温和或轻微；比较级 milder。

ex.en: She has remained loyal to the company through years of difficult change.
ex.zh: 多年艰难变革中，她始终忠于这家公司。

words.note: be loyal to 表忠于；名词 loyalty，反义为 disloyal。

ex.en: The new policy had a major impact on small businesses across the region.
ex.zh: 新政策对该地区的小企业产生了重大影响。

words.note: 作名词后接 on：have an impact on；作动词直接带宾语。

ex.en: The accident left him with partial paralysis in his left arm.
ex.zh: 那场事故使他左臂局部瘫痪。

words.note: para- 表旁边，-lysis 表松解；动词 paralyse 或 paralyze。

ex.en: The witness was asked to appear in court early the next morning.
ex.zh: 证人被要求第二天一早就出庭。

words.note: go to court 指起诉；in court 指在法庭上，一般不加 the。

ex.en: The old chapel at the edge of the village is now used as a museum.
ex.zh: 村边那座古老的小教堂如今被用作博物馆。

words.note: chapel 指小礼拜堂，规模小于 church，常为私人或机构所有。

ex.en: Some newspapers distort the facts in order to attract more readers.
ex.zh: 有些报纸为了吸引更多读者而歪曲事实。

words.note: dis- 表「离」，tort 表「扭」；名词 distortion 指歪曲。

ex.en: The group set up a subsidiary in Singapore to handle Asian sales.
ex.zh: 集团在新加坡设立子公司，负责亚洲销售业务。

words.note: sub- 表「下」，sid 表「坐」；作名词即子公司、附属机构。

ex.en: They decided to venture into the export business despite the high risks.
ex.zh: 尽管风险很高，他们还是决定涉足出口生意。

words.note: joint venture 是「合资企业」的固定说法；venture 也可作动词。

ex.en: It was hard to discern any difference between the two copies at a glance.
ex.zh: 乍一看很难分辨这两份副本有什么差别。

words.note: discern 比 see 正式，常接 difference 等词。

ex.en: The students showed great enthusiasm for the new reading programme.
ex.zh: 学生们对新阅读计划表现出极大热情。

words.note: enthusiasm 后接 for；形容词是 enthusiastic。

ex.en: The company offers flexible working hours to help parents with young children.
ex.zh: 公司提供弹性工作时间，以帮助有幼儿的员工。

words.note: flex 表「弯曲」，-ible 表「能…的」；名词 flexibility。

ex.en: These paintings are now in the public domain and can be freely reproduced.
ex.zh: 这些画作现已进入公有领域，可自由复制。

words.note: in the public domain 是版权用语；domain 也指领域、领地。

ex.en: The census shows that the population of the town has doubled in ten years.
ex.zh: 普查显示该镇人口十年间翻了一番。

words.note: census 可数，常用 take 或 conduct a census 表进行普查。

ex.en: Police found the corpse of a young man near the river bank.
ex.zh: 警方在河岸边发现了一具年轻男子的尸体。

words.note: corpse 指人的尸体；动物尸体多用 carcass，注意区分。

ex.en: The court fined him for willful damage to public property.
ex.zh: 法院因他故意损坏公共财产而对他罚款。

words.note: 美式拼作 willful，英式 wilful；多指故意违规或任性。

ex.en: Her positive attitude towards failure impressed everyone in the team.
ex.zh: 她面对失败的积极态度让队里每个人都很佩服。

words.note: attitude 后接 to 或 towards；作「姿势」义多用于文学描写。

ex.en: He invited only close relatives and a few old friends to the ceremony.
ex.zh: 他只邀请了近亲和几位老朋友参加仪式。

words.note: relative 作名词指亲戚；relative to 表「相对于」，书面常用。

ex.en: Compared with last year, the number of applicants has risen sharply.
ex.zh: 与去年相比，申请人数大幅上升。

words.note: compare with 表比较；compare to 多表「把…比作」。

ex.en: The novel depicts village life in the north during the war years.
ex.zh: 这部小说描绘了战争年代北方的乡村生活。

words.note: depict sb/sth as 表描绘成；名词 depiction 指描绘。

ex.en: The children hopped over the low wall and ran towards the lake.
ex.zh: 孩子们跳过矮墙，朝湖边跑去。

words.note: hop 指单脚或双脚短跳；jump 泛指跳，注意区分。

ex.en: Patience is a characteristic of good teachers rather than a sign of weakness.
ex.zh: 耐心是好老师的特征，而不是软弱的标志。

words.note: be characteristic of 表「为…所特有」；该词也可作名词。

ex.en: The report called for greater public involvement in decisions about the park.
ex.zh: 报告呼吁公众更多地参与公园相关决策。

words.note: involvement 后接 in；be involved in 表参与或卷入。

ex.en: The agreement paved the way for closer trade between the two countries.
ex.zh: 该协议为两国间更紧密的贸易铺平了道路。

words.note: pave the way for 是固定搭配；paved road 指铺装路。

ex.en: Regular practice is an integral part of learning any foreign language.
ex.zh: 经常练习是学习任何外语不可或缺的一部分。

words.note: integral 常与 part of 或 to 连用；动词 integrate 表整合。

ex.en: Oil is used to lubricate the moving parts of an engine.
ex.zh: 机油用来润滑发动机的运动部件。

words.note: lubricate 指加润滑油；名词 lubricant 指润滑剂。

ex.en: Halley's Comet returns to the inner solar system about every seventy-six years.
ex.zh: 哈雷彗星大约每七十六年返回内太阳系一次。

words.note: comet 源自希腊语「长毛的星」；哈雷彗星写作 Halley's Comet。

ex.en: The team worked all weekend to meet the deadline for the report.
ex.zh: 为按期完成报告，团队整个周末都在工作。

words.note: meet a deadline 按期完成，miss a deadline 错过期限。
